recap.text: Carl loots a hunter for an Arrow of Enthusiastic Double Gonorrhea and a crude map showing claims by the Hive and the Skull Empire. Carl uses Samantha to deliver missiles and a villain's soliloquy to put down another hunter. On the broadcast, Carl puts the Dream among the no votes because a man sent his family to die because someone said his mom is bangin'.

The Dream's cruiser threatens to nuke the planet after sponsors lose protections, but a Syndicate Peacekeeper hobbles the ship. The Dream then threatens to stop food production unless the Epitome family is evacuated. Aboard a converted garbage freighter, the view is that only reason and negotiation stop AIs once they realize their control.

Quasar prepares a warning before the sixty-hour ceasefire expires. The Dream buys the Vengeance of the Daughter and presses for a guaranteed third season. The Bone Clan leaves the Bloc, leaving the Blood Sultanate, the Madness, and the Reavers. Epitome Tagg dies and the Dream is beaten. Team Retribution and the Princess Posse are the only two teams remaining.

beats.headline: A hunter of theirs, and the map on his body
beats.text: The group takes one of their hunters down and Carl loots him: an Arrow of Enthusiastic Double Gonorrhea, and a crude map of the hunting grounds with a territory marked for every outfit working them. That is the first honest look anyone gets at how the hunt is organised. The Hive and the Skull Empire have both put a claim on Carl and Donut. The Dream have their own reasons for being here.
beats.gist: The group takes down a hunter and Carl loots an Arrow of Enthusiastic Double Gonorrhea.

beats.headline: Elves at the door
beats.text: Two or three of the elves get a catapult set up and walk gas-rock artillery across the town. Carl uses Samantha to deliver missiles, delivers a villain's soliloquy while he is at it, and puts down another of their hunters.
beats.gist: Carl uses Samantha to deliver missiles and a villain's soliloquy while elves use gas-rock artillery.

beats.headline: Mister Gonorrhea Arrow
beats.text: On the broadcast, Carl puts the Dream among the no votes, its man too much of a walking abscess to change his mind despite sending members of his own family to die on this floor because someone said his mom is bangin'. Donut adds that she is quite attractive for a bald woman. On the walk to the stairs, Carl says he thinks the Dream will vote yes after all. They can change their votes right up until the start.
beats.gist: Carl puts the Dream among the no votes because its man is a walking abscess.

beats.headline: Threats over a lost vote
beats.text: The loss of the sponsors' protections does not go quietly. The Dream's cruiser threatens to nuke the planet over it, and is hobbled by a Syndicate Peacekeeper before it can. The Dream then threatens to stop food production unless the Epitome family is evacuated. They can scream and threaten all they want. Aboard a converted garbage freighter, the view is that once these AIs realise how much control they really have, the only thing stopping them is reason, and negotiation.
beats.gist: The Dream threatens to nuke the planet, but a Syndicate Peacekeeper hobbles the cruiser.

beats.headline: They buy a storyline instead of fighting for one
beats.text: Quasar has the warning ready before the sixty-hour ceasefire is out. The Dream have bought out the Vengeance of the Daughter and are pressing for fulfilment of the guaranteed third season written into it. An entertainment company, bought and aimed at a crawler.
beats.gist: Quasar prepares a warning before the sixty-hour ceasefire expires.

beats.headline: They walk out of the Bloc
beats.text: The Bone Clan goes with them. What is left of the alliance is the Blood Sultanate, the Madness and the Reavers, which is a smaller thing than it was that morning.
beats.gist: The Bone Clan leaves the Bloc, leaving a smaller alliance of the Blood Sultanate, Madness and Reavers.

beats.headline: Epitome Tagg is dead, the Dream is finished
beats.text: Emberus wants Samantha interrogated and intends to break the floor in sixty-six minutes whatever the answer. In the middle of that, the Dream is beaten. Epitome Tagg is dead. Two teams remain standing on this floor, the Princess Posse and Team Retribution, and neither of them is the one that owned half the food in the universe.
beats.gist: Emberus wants Samantha interrogated before he breaks the floor in sixty-six minutes; Epitome Tagg is dead.
